_note: The damage types an Epic energy resistance is chosen from. There is no category and no page per type: the set is a sentence, and it is taken from the two feat pages that give it, which must agree. No gate of either kind: both pages name the same five and neither excludes any, so writing `selectable: true` five times would state a rule nobody wrote.

_chosen_by.quote: The choices for types of energy are [[acid damage|acid]], [[cold damage|cold]], [[electrical damage|electrical]], [[fire damage|fire]], and [[sonic damage|sonic]].

corroborated_by.quote: The character gains [[damage resistance|resistance]] 10 to the selected damage type ([[acid damage|acid]], [[cold damage|cold]], [[electrical damage|electrical]], [[fire damage|fire]], or [[sonic damage|sonic]]).
